<thought>We need a template that describes a Friedel‑Crafts acylation: it breaks a halide (the Cl of an acyl chloride) and forms a ketone on the aromatic ring. Using the valid functional‑group list, “halide” is the broken group and “ketones” is the formed group. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria to obtain candidate templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2Cl)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
